definitions.short: to detrude , i.e. (intransitively and figuratively) become derelict (wrongly practise; namely, idolatry)
definitions.full: H7750. sut [ שׂוּט ] verb swerve, fall away (akin to שָׂטָה q. v.; Late Hebrew סוּט Hiph`il is shake, move away ; Assyrian šâ‰u , rebel , Meissn 90 ; Ethiopic : bring back, restore ; in ᵑ9 apostatize is סְטָא ); — Qal Participle plural construct כָזָב וֶשָׂטֵי Psa 40:5 those falling away to falsehood (Gunk Schöpf. 40 וְשָׂטָה ).
